description: Declared mutants of v8-engine-voxel-mesh-contract (gyo.voxel_mesh in GYO::VoxelMesh, docs/architecture/voxel-mesh.md; judgment V5 of the declaration in docs/tools/plans/v8/voxel-map-editor.md), run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/tools/plans/v8/scripts/voxel_mesh_mutations.json --build-dir build/target/_build/test. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. Test-case filters must not contain commas: doctest splits -tc on commas, and a filter that matches nothing passes.

mutants.what: A repeated key is taken silently (the DOM keeps the last)
An unknown field is ignored
A version other than 1 is accepted
source_sha256 of any length is accepted
A palette entry with fewer than six face colours is accepted
mutants.find: if (!faces.is_array() || faces.size() != FaceCount) Fail("faces lists six colours", path + ".faces");
mutants.replace:
if (!faces.is_array() || faces.size() > FaceCount) Fail("faces lists six colours", path + ".faces");
    if (faces.size() < FaceCount) return {name.get<std::string>(), {}};

mutants.what: dir 6 is accepted
mutants.find: if (v[3] < 0 || v[3] >= static_cast<std::int64_t>(FaceCount)) Fail("dir is 0 to 5", At(path, 3));
mutants.replace: if (v[3] < 0 || v[3] > static_cast<std::int64_t>(FaceCount)) Fail("dir is 0 to 5", At(path, 3));

mutants.what: A quad of width 0 is accepted
mutants.find: if (v[4] < 1) Fail("width is at least 1", At(path, 4));
mutants.replace: if (v[4] < 0) Fail("width is at least 1", At(path, 4));

mutants.what: A collider with min equal to max on an axis is accepted
mutants.find: if (!(minimum[axis] < maximum[axis])) Fail("min is below max on every axis", path);
mutants.replace: if (!(minimum[axis] <= maximum[axis])) Fail("min is below max on every axis", path);

mutants.what: Coordinates beyond +-2^20 units are accepted
mutants.find: if (units < -CoordinateLimit || units > CoordinateLimit) Fail("a coordinate lies beyond +-2^20 units", path);

mutants.what: Only a quad's minimum corner is range-checked
Quads out of canonical order are accepted
A text over 16 MiB is parsed
mutants.find: if (text.size() > MaxTextBytes) Fail("the text exceeds 16 MiB", "");

mutants.what: +Z faces are wound counter-clockwise
mutants.find: corners = {world(x0, y0, z0), world(x1, y0, z0), world(x1, y1, z0), world(x0, y1, z0)};
mutants.replace: corners = {world(x0, y1, z0), world(x1, y1, z0), world(x1, y0, z0), world(x0, y0, z0)};

mutants.what: The uv samples a texel corner instead of its centre
The origin is added in cells instead of 1/16 units
The conversion forgets to divide by 16
Two identical colliders are accepted
cell_size below 2^-16 is accepted
Repeated keys are caught only inside nested objects
GYO::VoxelMesh gains a link it must not have (Design Invariant 1)
mutants.find: target_link_libraries(gyo_voxel_mesh PUBLIC GYO::Base GYO::Math PRIVATE nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
mutants.replace: target_link_libraries(gyo_voxel_mesh PUBLIC GYO::Base GYO::Math GYO::Collision PRIVATE nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
